text: {"assertions":["A flaky job in build/ci/pipeline.yml only triggered with deeply nested inputs exceeding six levels deep.","The flaky job manifested as a minority of test runs failing inconsistently.","The root cause was a race condition in lazy initialization of the CI pipeline.","The fix guarded the lazy initialization with a double-checked lock pattern.","The fix was submitted as PR #4650 on branch fix/flaky-job-1.","The flaky job was reproduced by rerunning the same commit ten times.","After the fix, the job completed in 35 minutes instead of 2 hours."]}
